name: sketch-day-runner
description: Runs the sketch day end to end, scouting Lightning Demos, setting up the four-step sketch, and generating machine concepts that compete on the wall under the adoption rule, part of the Design Sprint Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run sketch-day-runner", "find lightning demos", "run the sketch day", "generate concepts for the sprint", "prepare Crazy 8s", "what do we do on Tuesday", or when the target is chosen and the room needs concepts to choose between tomorrow. Use it even for a vague ask like "find me examples of how other people solved this".
